CREATE PROCEDURE [CFG].[HIST_STG_Products] AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	DECLARE @StartDate datetime = GETDATE()
	DECLARE	
		@StartDateStr varchar(30) = CONVERT(varchar(30), @StartDate, 121),
		@CloseDate datetime = DATEADD(ms, -2, @StartDate),
		@Inserted int = 0, 
		@Deleted int = 0, 
		@Updated int = 0
	
	EXEC [LOG].[PACKAGE_RUN_LOG_ENTRY] 
		@PackageName = 'HIST_STG_Products', 
		@TableName = '[STG].[Products]', 
		@StartTimeStr = @StartDateStr, 
		@Inserted = NULL, 
		@Updated = NULL, 
		@Deleted = NULL

	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM [IMP].[Products] GROUP BY [ProductID] HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Table [IMP].[Products] contains duplicated data and cannot be historized', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [STG].[Products] WHERE [DAT_VON_HIST] >= @StartDate)
		DELETE FROM [STG].[Products] WHERE [DAT_VON_HIST] >= @StartDate

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [STG].[Products] WHERE @StartDate BETWEEN [DAT_VON_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] <> '99991231')
		UPDATE [STG].[Products]
			SET [DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231'
		WHERE 
			@StartDate BETWEEN [DAT_VON_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] <> '99991231'

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [STG].[Products] WHERE [DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231')
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [STG].[Products](
			[CategoryID],
			[Discontinued],
			[ProductID],
			[ProductName],
			[QuantityPerUnit],
			[ReorderLevel],
			[SupplierID],
			[UnitPrice],
			[UnitsInStock],
			[UnitsOnOrder],
			[DAT_VON_HIST],
			[DAT_BIS_HIST])
		SELECT 
			I.[CategoryID],
			I.[Discontinued],
			I.[ProductID],
			I.[ProductName],
			I.[QuantityPerUnit],
			I.[ReorderLevel],
			I.[SupplierID],
			I.[UnitPrice],
			I.[UnitsInStock],
			I.[UnitsOnOrder], 
			@StartDate, 
			'99991231'
		FROM 
			[IMP].[Products] I

		SET @Inserted = @Inserted + @@ROWCOUNT

		GOTO FINISH
	END

	CREATE TABLE #T 
	(
		[CategoryID] int,
		[Discontinued] bit,
		[ProductID] int,
		[ProductName] nvarchar(40),
		[QuantityPerUnit] nvarchar(20),
		[ReorderLevel] smallint,
		[SupplierID] int,
		[UnitPrice] money,
		[UnitsInStock] smallint,
		[UnitsOnOrder] smallint,
		[SATZ_ID] bigint, 
		[DAT_VON_HIST] datetime,
		HIST_SCD_TYPE int,
		[DAT_BIS_HIST_PREV] datetime
	)

	INSERT INTO #T([CategoryID],
		[Discontinued],
		[ProductID],
		[ProductName],
		[QuantityPerUnit],
		[ReorderLevel],
		[SupplierID],
		[UnitPrice],
		[UnitsInStock],
		[UnitsOnOrder], 
		[SATZ_ID], 
		[DAT_VON_HIST], 
		HIST_SCD_TYPE, 
		[DAT_BIS_HIST_PREV])
	SELECT
		I.[CategoryID],
		I.[Discontinued],
		I.[ProductID],
		I.[ProductName],
		I.[QuantityPerUnit],
		I.[ReorderLevel],
		I.[SupplierID],
		I.[UnitPrice],
		I.[UnitsInStock],
		I.[UnitsOnOrder], 
		S.[SATZ_ID],
		S.[DAT_VON_HIST],
		2 HIST_SCD_TYPE,
		NULL
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
			[CategoryID],
			[Discontinued],
			[ProductID],
			[ProductName],
			[QuantityPerUnit],
			[ReorderLevel],
			[SupplierID],
			[UnitPrice],
			[UnitsInStock],
			[UnitsOnOrder]
		FROM
			[IMP].[Products] I
		EXCEPT SELECT 
			[CategoryID],
			[Discontinued],
			[ProductID],
			[ProductName],
			[QuantityPerUnit],
			[ReorderLevel],
			[SupplierID],
			[UnitPrice],
			[UnitsInStock],
			[UnitsOnOrder]
		FROM
			[STG].[Products] S (NOLOCK)
		WHERE 
			[DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231'
	) I
	LEFT JOIN [STG].[Products] S (NOLOCK) ON
		S.[DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231' AND
		(S.[ProductID] = I.[ProductID])

	UPDATE H
	SET [DAT_BIS_HIST] = @CloseDate
	FROM
		#T T
		INNER JOIN [STG].[Products] H ON
			H.[SATZ_ID] = T.[SATZ_ID]
	WHERE
		T.[SATZ_ID] IS NOT NULL AND
		T.HIST_SCD_TYPE = 2 AND
		T.[DAT_VON_HIST] < @StartDate

	SET @Updated = @Updated + @@ROWCOUNT

	INSERT INTO [STG].[Products]([CategoryID],
		[Discontinued],
		[ProductID],
		[ProductName],
		[QuantityPerUnit],
		[ReorderLevel],
		[SupplierID],
		[UnitPrice],
		[UnitsInStock],
		[UnitsOnOrder], [DAT_VON_HIST], [DAT_BIS_HIST])
	SELECT 
		[CategoryID],
		[Discontinued],
		[ProductID],
		[ProductName],
		[QuantityPerUnit],
		[ReorderLevel],
		[SupplierID],
		[UnitPrice],
		[UnitsInStock],
		[UnitsOnOrder], @StartDate, '99991231'
	FROM 
		#T T
	WHERE
		([SATZ_ID] IS NULL OR HIST_SCD_TYPE = 2)

	SET @Inserted = @Inserted + @@ROWCOUNT

	UPDATE S
	SET 
		[DAT_BIS_HIST] = @CloseDate
	FROM
		[STG].[Products] S
	WHERE
		[DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231' AND
		[DAT_VON_HIST] < @StartDate AND
		NOT EXISTS 
		(
		SELECT 1 FROM
			[IMP].[Products] I (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
			(S.[ProductID] = I.[ProductID])
		)

	SET @Deleted = @Deleted + @@ROWCOUNT
FINISH:

	UPDATE STATISTICS [STG].[Products]

	EXEC [LOG].[PACKAGE_RUN_LOG_ENTRY] 
		@PackageName = 'HIST_STG_Products', 
		@TableName = '[STG].[Products]', 
		@StartTimeStr = @StartDateStr, 
		@Inserted = @Inserted, 
		@Updated = @Updated, 
		@Deleted = @Deleted
END
